name: Bronzeguard Kingdom
description: The kingdom of the dwarves, exporting raw minerals, weapons, and armor. It is currently at war with the Order of Truespawn.

name: Homeward Reach
description: A dense taiga zone at high elevation, filled with secrets and serving as the ancestral home of the Waxborn.

name: Amber Coast
description: A coastal region lined with spires of sedimentary rock along the waterline. It is home to thieves, con artists, and some of the less fortunate people of Caelora.

name: Verdant Expanses
description: A vast expanse of plains in the center of Caelora, dotted with small settlements. It serves as a connection point for the island's various factions and regions.

name: The Highlands
description: The Highlands of Caelora, once home to the stone giants and now under the dominion of Var'Kennan.

name: Starfall Forest
description: A forested region of Caelora, filled with wondrous sights and dangerous wild magic. It is home to many of the more exotic races that inhabit the island.

name: Kjerne
description:
The true center of Caelora, built around the enormous Great Tree of Kjerne. It is home to Vae'Saron and those who worship him, and is frequently alive with parties, festivals, and celebrations of the blessing of life.

Notable Landmarks: Wedding Platform, Grandroot Bathhouse, The Root & Branch, Whispering Garden, Canopy Market

name: Wigston
description:
A quaint town that serves as a checkpoint between Starfall Forest, the Highlands, and the Amber Coast.

Notable Landmarks: Drift Provisions, Tidemark Shrine, The Steel Talon, The Good Rock

name: Avilan
description: Home to the avian races of Caelora. Built among the towering trees of Starfall Forest, it is a peaceful place of wonder where many of the greatest spellcasters alive reside.

name: Chord
description:
A destitute town built into a gaping ravine and suspended by ropes and pulleys. It is known for its high-quality threads and serves as a religious center for Nihleia.

Notable Landmarks: Raven Bridge, Mossen Alcove, Threadmaker's District, Willow's Roost, Raven's Rest
